title: Nourishing Rich Moroccan Lamb Mrouzia
description: A resinous and pillowy Moroccan dish featuring lamb, mayonnaise, and a rich deglaze fond, made low-fat-friendly, in the traditional form of mrouzia. This indulgent dish is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pot, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Add the mayonnaise, honey, raisins, almonds, cinnamon, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, cooking for 2.5 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the lamb and onion mixture from the pot and place it on a serving platter.
Place the pot over medium heat and bring the sauce to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
